basic_info.description: I'm Nicolas Delgado, a dynamic full-stack software engineer based in Toronto. I build and support high-quality technical solutions across product platforms and enterprise environments — from TypeScript/Node.js systems and PostgreSQL/MongoDB data layers to workflow automation, third-party integrations, and AI evaluation work. Experienced in Agile delivery with cross-functional teams, I care about clear UX, reliable APIs, and systems that scale with real business complexity. I work in Spanish, English, and French.

projects.title: Immiland Sign
projects.description: Designed and built a production e-signature platform covering templates, signing workflows, and payment collection on contracts. Primary author of the web application and API, from technical design through testing, deployment, monitoring, and production support.

impact_detail.problem: The organization needed a lower-cost way to run document signing in production without remaining dependent on a third-party e-signature vendor.
impact_detail.ownership: Primary author with end-to-end ownership of the web application and API, from technical design through testing, deployment, monitoring, and production support.
impact_detail.delivery: A production e-signature product covering templates, signing workflows, and payment collection on contracts.
impact_detail.availability_note: Corporate login required — public access is not available.

projects.title: PIE Placement Exam Platform
projects.description: Built a full language placement product: consent and identity verification, multi-section exams (listening, reading, writing, speaking), results and verifiable certificates, admin tooling, and i18n. Paired with a FastAPI + scikit-learn scoring service for CEFR/DELF-oriented level prediction and rubric breakdowns — used in production for PIE language assessment.

impact_detail.problem: Language programs needed a reliable way to place learners with automated assessment, scoring, and results instead of manual evaluation.
impact_detail.ownership: Built and launched the placement-testing platform end-to-end, including assessment flows and the scoring service used in production.
impact_detail.delivery: A full placement product with multi-section exams, automated scoring, results, and operational workflows used weekly by learners.

projects.title: Affiliate & Agency Partner Hub
projects.description: Delivered a Next.js partner portal for agencies: leads, student progress, invoicing, RBAC, Google Sheets sync, and Genkit AI helpers for sheet-driven workflows. Connected to Apps Script JWT auth and onboarding flows so affiliates can operate against Immiland's backend with a clear operational cockpit.

projects.title: Immiland Foundation
projects.description: Built the public humanitarian portal for Immiland Foundation: missions, donation transparency, impact dashboards, volunteer onboarding, reported needs, Stripe donations, and admin tooling. React + Vite + TypeScript frontend with Framer Motion, connected to Immiland APIs and deployed on Google Cloud Run.

projects.title: Consultation Booking Platform
projects.description: Built a Calendly-style replacement for Immiland Law consultations: syncs consultants' Google Calendars for real availability, lets clients book immigration appointments, collects payment through Stripe, sends reminder emails, and creates calendar events for all guests automatically. Used on live service pages such as pre-shipment / application review scheduling.

projects.title: CRS Calculator & Dashboard
projects.description: Full-stack Express Entry CRS scoring tool with configurable rules, interactive React calculator, language-score logic, and syncing against official immigration data sources. Built end-to-end with a focus on clarity and accurate point calculation.

projects.title: Immiland Flow — Client Purchases
projects.description: Client-facing purchase experience for immigration services: Stripe checkout, province-aware tax logic, service quotation flows, and responsive UX improvements across English and French.

projects.description: Ongoing full-stack work on Immiland's core operations platform — features, bug fixes, and UX across contracts, consultations, education, messaging, and payments. Stack: React, NestJS, PostgreSQL, real-time notifications, and third-party integrations.

projects.title: Cinerama
